issue_context.title: Support concurrent DDL
issue_context.body:
## Support concurrent DDL

This issue is used to keep tracking of the development of "concurrent DDL"

Ref https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/issues/18396

## SPEC
SPEC describes what we want to do exactly from the user's perspective.
You can leave your comment on the document if you have any suggestions or questions.
Chinese version: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1s1ju_Ubmo2aEIF5hDWBBALnqZ2CHKNiFAaBp85NyRXQ/edit# 
English version: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1e6B-GIIZn3elN02ub4jkCyqcUhcjUAKKaDAAphkg2ss/edit#

review_comments: Please add the reason for adding these functions here to the PR description.
it already has some functions related to txn like `StmtCommit` , `StmtRollback`, and it very naturally adds `rollbackTxn` etc.
the `session.context` will be used in ddl job operation, and only general ddls allowed to be executed when TiKV is disk full. So we will use `SetDiskFullOpt` method to control it
Could we remove the function of `testNewContext`? And why?
not now, there are still some other usage
Why add this struct or make this change？
we will add another implementation(concurrent ddl implementation) for `LastJobIterator` in the future
